figurative_meaning_en: Out of control; completely messed up (often due to excessive drinking)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে অনেক পান করে সে একেবারে আউট হয়ে গেছে।
এত রাগে সে আউট হয়ে উঠেছে, কিছুতেই শান্ত হচ্ছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He drank so much at the party that he was completely out.
He's so angry he's out of control and won't calm down.
history: This idiom is a modern loanword from English 'out', likely influenced by cricket terminology or general slang for being unconscious/drunk, adapted into urban Bengali speech during British colonial times or post-independence.
note: Primarily used in colloquial Bengali to describe intoxication or loss of control; reflects linguistic borrowing in contemporary urban culture.
